title: AIDRA — Constraint Profiles
description: Performance of the same scene and model under space-grade hardware constraint profiles, with a pass/fail verdict against each profile's RAM and CPU budget. Cue runs (AOI crops) and runs from the pre-affine-mask era (before 2026-08-16) are excluded.

list.name: variant
list.label: Variant
list.description: Model variant by compression technique. Public dashboards do not interpolate variables and always show the FP32 baseline.

options.content:
HOW TO READ THIS DASHBOARD
The same Sentinel-1 scene processed by the same model under five simulated hardware budgets (ground → sat-extreme). The scene is chosen automatically: the most recent one attempted under all five profiles, and each panel shows the latest attempt per profile. The model is the FP32 baseline unless a Variant is picked above (logged-in Grafana only). RAM is enforced: a run whose peak RSS exceeds its budget is aborted and shows as a failure. The verdict table right below is the evidence row for each profile.

panels.title: Profile Budget Verdict (Pass / Fail)
panels.description: Same scene, same model: each bar is the latest attempt per profile on the most recent scene that was attempted under all five profiles (FP32 baseline unless a Variant is picked; cue crops and pre-affine-mask runs excluded). Verdict per profile against the declared budget. PASS = completed within the RAM budget. FAIL_RAM_ABORTED = the memory guard stopped the run because peak RSS exceeded the budget (enforced since 2026-09). FAIL_RAM_OVER_BUDGET = the run completed but used more RAM than the budget (runs from before the guard was enforced). WARN_CPU = completed within RAM but used more than 110% of the CPU budget. FAIL_RUN = any other failure. NO DATA = no qualifying scene.

targets.rawSql:
WITH budgets(profile, cpu_budget_cores, ram_budget_mb) AS (
    VALUES
        ('ground', 4.0, 24576),
        ('sat-high', 2.0, 4096),
        ('sat-mid', 1.0, 2048),
        ('sat-low', 0.5, 1024),
        ('sat-extreme', 0.25, 512)
), scoped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM execution_log
    WHERE trigger_type <> 'cue'
        AND status IN ('success', 'error', 'failed')
        AND image_hash <> 'pending'
        AND (notes IS NULL OR notes NOT LIKE '%methodology:%')
        -- public dashboards do not interpolate variables: default to the FP32 baseline
        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(compression_technique, ''), 'none')
            = CASE WHEN LEFT('$variant', 1) = '$' THEN 'none' ELSE '$variant' END
), scene AS (
    -- same scene, same model: the most recent scene attempted under all five profiles
    SELECT image_hash
    FROM scoped
    GROUP BY image_hash
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT constraint_profile) = 5
    ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC
    LIMIT 1
), latest AS (
    -- the latest attempt per profile on that scene
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (constraint_profile)
        constraint_profile AS profile,
        status,
        created_at,
        image_title,
        inference_ms,
        cpu_usage_pct,
        num_detections,
        avg_confidence,
        error_message,
        COALESCE(peak_ram_mb, (substring(error_message from 'peak RSS ([0-9.]+) MB'))::float) AS peak_mb
    FROM scoped
    WHERE image_hash = (SELECT image_hash FROM scene)
    ORDER BY constraint_profile, created_at DESC
)
SELECT
    b.profile,
    CASE
        WHEN l.profile IS NULL THEN 'NO DATA'
        WHEN l.status <> 'success' AND l.error_message LIKE '%memory budget exceeded%' THEN 'FAIL_RAM_ABORTED'
        WHEN l.status <> 'success' THEN 'FAIL_RUN'
        WHEN l.peak_mb > b.ram_budget_mb THEN 'FAIL_RAM_OVER_BUDGET'
        WHEN (l.cpu_usage_pct / 100.0) > (b.cpu_budget_cores * 1.10) THEN 'WARN_CPU'
        ELSE 'PASS'
    END AS budget_verdict,
    l.status AS run_status,
    b.ram_budget_mb,
    ROUND(l.peak_mb::numeric, 0) AS peak_ram_mb,
    ROUND((l.peak_mb / NULLIF(b.ram_budget_mb, 0))::numeric, 2) AS ram_budget_ratio,
    b.cpu_budget_cores,
    ROUND((l.cpu_usage_pct / 100.0)::numeric, 2) AS observed_cores,
    ROUND((l.inference_ms / 60000.0)::numeric, 1) AS latency_min,
    l.num_detections AS detections,
    ROUND(l.avg_confidence::numeric, 3) AS avg_confidence,
    l.created_at AS run_at,
    l.image_title AS scene
FROM budgets b
LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.profile = b.profile
ORDER BY CASE b.profile
    WHEN 'ground' THEN 1
    WHEN 'sat-high' THEN 2
    WHEN 'sat-mid' THEN 3
    WHEN 'sat-low' THEN 4
    WHEN 'sat-extreme' THEN 5
END

panels.title: Inference latency per profile
panels.description: Same scene, same model: each bar is the latest attempt per profile on the most recent scene that was attempted under all five profiles (FP32 baseline unless a Variant is picked; cue crops and pre-affine-mask runs excluded). Only profiles whose run completed have a bar: a run aborted by the memory guard has no latency. sat-low and sat-extreme are slower because of the soft duty-cycle CPU throttle.

panels.title: Detections per profile (output stability check)
panels.description: Same scene, same model: each bar is the latest attempt per profile on the most recent scene that was attempted under all five profiles (FP32 baseline unless a Variant is picked; cue crops and pre-affine-mask runs excluded). Completed runs only. FP32 is deterministic: the same scene must give the same detections under every profile, so any difference is a failure.
